name: Shoulder Press & Push-up at the Footbar

load.note: Shoulder press (carriage moves): R, RY to advance. Push-up (carriage still): B, or Y for more core.

summary: Kneeling on the carriage in a half plank with hands on the footbar. Either press the carriage away with the arms, or hold it still and do push-ups.
steps: Kneel on the carriage, hands on the footbar a little wider than the shoulders, feet against the shoulder rests.
Press the carriage out slightly into a half plank, chest over the bar.
Shoulder press: stay low; breathe out to push the carriage away by straightening the arms, breathe in to bend.
Push-up: hold the carriage still; bend the elbows wide to lower the chest to the bar and press up.

layers.title: Hands and knees
layers.text: Knees under the hips for the easiest version.

cues:
Head, ribs and hips move as one piece.
Elbows track out to the sides.
Chin stays off the chest; shoulders don't round.
Elbows never lock.

review.note: Draft entry written for OpenPilates. Needs review by a qualified Pilates instructor before teaching from it.

variations.name: Less spring is easier on the shoulders but harder on the core — pick what the person needs
